title: One place for product and partner data.
body: I turned scattered spreadsheets, emails, and files into connected databases for products, partners, and agreements, and kept them accurate.
detail: The company licenses its ingredient brand to partner brands worldwide. Knowing which products use it, at what dose, and under which signed agreement was spread across inboxes and files.

sections.label: THE PROBLEM
sections.copy: Answering basic questions took hours: Which partner products are on shelf? Is each one compliant? When does its agreement renew? The answers lived in different places and were often out of date.

sections.label: WHAT I BUILT
sections.copy: A product database with verified ingredient and compliance details, a partner agreement tracker with renewal alerts, and a public, brand-first product finder built from the same data. I audited every partner across four regions to fill the gaps.

sections.label: THE RESULT
sections.copy: One source the team trusts. Missing agreements were found and flagged, renewal dates no longer hide in old files, and new staff can get up to speed from the system instead of from people.

sections.label: NOTE
sections.copy: Summarized without employer names, records, counts, or screenshots.
